intro: Explore the planned single and bulk domain inputs. Live spam scores are unavailable.
aboutTitle: What can I do with the preview?
about: You can enter a domain or try the bulk workflow. The preview cannot retrieve spam metrics or diagnose search penalties.
example: Enter an example domain to see the input flow. Use the original data provider when you need a measured score.

faqs.question: Does a spam score confirm a Google penalty?
faqs.answer: A third-party score describes that provider’s metric. Check verified Search Console data for manual actions on a site you manage.
